title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: email resolution answers customer emails without creating a case
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documents administrator enablement, autonomous email responses and consumption-based billing. Minor corrections should complete two navigation paths, acknowledge the differing capacity-enforcement descriptions and reconcile the rollout checklist with the controls table.
